title: Residency-aware Adhoc Audit Kit and Timeboxed Report Dispatch
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Deliver a flexible "adhoc audit kit" that can produce residency-aware, timeboxed evidence packages (PDF + CSV) and reliably dispatch them on schedule to customer-specified sinks. The feature must support tenant-scoped retention policies, per-region export routing, and an auditable reconciliation step so customers and internal controls can verify delivered packages. Scope includes: export generator (templated PDF + CSV rows), delivery adapters (S3, SFTP, secure email, pre-signed links), scheduling engine with timezone/residency awareness, immutable snapshot store for proofs, and a reconciliation job that produces a signed manifest for each dispatch. Non-goals: deep MDM connectors (Salesforce, SAP), live interactive dashboards for end-users (we will deliver monitoring dashboards for admins). Success metrics: exports succeed >= 99.5% within SLA window; reconciliation detects and auto-retries missing deliveries within 1 hour; mean time to recovery for failed dispatch <= 30 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a timeboxed export job specifying tenant, region(s), retention window, format (PDF+CSV) and delivery sink
Generated PDF includes standardized evidence header, per-record anonymization/redaction flags, and signed manifest with checksum
Exports respect data residency: data for EU tenants only leaves via EU-region sinks or via approved cross-region transfer policy
A reconciliation job runs post-dispatch and emits a 'delivery verified' signal or creates a retry ticket; retries limited and audited
Console shows per-job status, last-run telemetry (duration, bytes, records), and a link to the signed manifest
Operations runbook exists for common failures and includes run_cmds and escalation path to SRE and compliance teams
tasks: Design PDF template and CSV schema with Design (DES-772)
Define export manifest spec and signing approach (KMS/HSM) with Security
Implement export generator service with residency filters and retention enforcement
Build delivery adapters: S3 (region-aware), SFTP, secure email with signed link
Implement scheduler with timezone-aware cron and per-tenant push windows
Add reconciliation worker that verifies checksums and updates job status
Wire Console dashboard surface and export telemetry metrics
Add e2e tests and a chaos scenario for delivery failures
